caption:
A missile strike has hit Nasser hospital in southern Gaza, resulting in six deaths according to the local health ministry.

This facility serves as the main medical hub for the region.

Witnesses report the impact occurred within the building that houses the surgical wards and intensive care units. This event is significant due to the critical nature of the services provided at this specific location.
